5.x: **Eastward launch:** uses the Earth's **west-to-east rotation** (a free speed boost); sites **nearer the equator** gain most. The boost does not give escape velocity – an orbiting satellite never reaches **escape velocity**.
**Polar / SSO launches** go **southward** (from Sriharikota a **dog-leg around Sri Lanka**).
**Sriharikota** (**SDSC-SHAR**, Andhra Pradesh), on the **east coast**: rockets fly over the sea; all Indian orbital launches, including private ones, go from here.
